symptom: quote-api pods run but never become Ready. Nothing crashes.
root_cause: quote-api sets CACHE_HOST to the short name redis, but the redis Service is in namespace parts-cache, not parts-quote. A short name resolves only in the pod's own namespace, so the readiness check's lookup of redis fails (no such host) and the pods stay not ready. It needs redis.parts-cache (or the full name).
